context:
# Goal
One unjudged kake round-20 audit, owned by the interactive L1. Province: web properties and publishing; single axis move is citation-local freshness detection. Read plans/wwkd-round-20-citation-locality.md first.
# Contract
Only writable repository: /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kake-shokunin. Each member writes only its own report under .ufo/round-20/wave/members; parent alone integrates all shared files. All other repositories/substrates are read-only. No push, config/routing changes, installs, external HTTP, credential contents, environment dumps, native transcript bodies or raw journal messages. Leaf only: no delegation/background jobs. Every specialist MUST skip build/lint/tests/formatters; L1 runs acceptance after integration. Evidence is advisory, never Rust judgment or non-author promotion verification. Route prerequisites must already be satisfied by the host before dispatch: content @m_composer; audit @m_grok; connector @m_antigravity with @m_zfl fallback. If your effective route differs, report it without substituting.
Each report names inspected paths/lines, findings, evidence limitations and unblock. Do not infer live HTTP status from old prose.
